scenes.vo: Vivo X500 comes to India on November twenty sixth. Here is what is confirmed, and what is only a leak.
scenes.cap: Vivo X500 India launch: 26 Nov. Confirmed vs leaked.

scenes.vo: Confirmed by Vivo: the India launch date, and a teased new red finish.
scenes.cap: Confirmed: India launch date + a new red finish (teaser)

scenes.vo: In China, the base X500 has a Dimensity ninety six hundred M chip, a six point five nine inch 144 hertz screen, and a seventy five hundred milliamp hour battery.
The China X500 Pro Max has a two hundred megapixel Zeiss telephoto camera and an eight thousand milliamp hour battery.
scenes.cap: X500 Pro Max (China): 200MP Zeiss telephoto, 8,000 mAh

scenes.vo: The X500 charges at ninety watts wired, and forty watts wireless.
Not confirmed: India prices and the India line up. Leaked prices vary widely, so wait for the twenty sixth.
scenes.cap: Not confirmed: India prices and line-up. Leaks vary widely.
